subject: Lumina Health trial — kickoff checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@luminahealth.com>, Mike Patel <mike.patel@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumina Health trial — kickoff checklist & next steps

Hi Emily / Mike,

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and the small set of items we agreed would unblock the pilot: 

1) Objective & success metrics
   - Validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization in the triage flow (3k notes/day).
   - Success: 85% accuracy vs. baseline on our eval set + <300ms tail latency at 99th pct for short notes.

2) Trial scope & timeline
   - 4-week sandbox trial starting once access is provided (staging dataset + 2 engineer touchpoints).

3) Access & security items we need from Lumina
   - Test S3 bucket access (read-only) or a sample dataset export (~200 examples).
   - List of allowed IPs / firewall rules for our staging cluster.
   - Any PII redaction requirements or privacy constraints.

4) Redwood deliverables
   - Network/security factsheet (attached).
   - Trial kickoff runbook and onboarding session (we recommended a 60–90 minute pairing session).

Next steps we agreed on:
- Emily to share the staging data sample + IPs by EOD Friday (4/9).
- We schedule the onboarding pairing session for week of 4/12 once access is available.

If there’s anything I missed, flag it — otherwise I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm access.

Attachments: redwood-network-security-factsheet.pdf (stub), lumina-trial-brief.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0132 | dylan_brooks@redwood.ai

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for teams

From: Emily Zhang <emily@luminahealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 13:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumina Health trial — kickoff checklist & next steps

Hi Dylan — thanks for the clear notes. This matches our internal summary. Quick answers: 

- I can upload a 200-record CSV sample to the secure folder by Monday (4/6).
- I’ll confirm the list of IPs for our security team to allow by the same day.
- No special PII redaction beyond standard PHI handling; I’ll include our security contact on the follow-up.

I have a conflict the week of 4/12; can we aim for 4/19 for the onboarding pairing session instead? Mike will join as well.

Emily Zhang
Director, Clinical Analytics
Lumina Health
emily@luminahealth.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@luminahealth.com>, Mike Patel <mike.patel@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumina Health trial — kickoff checklist & next steps

Hey Emily — small nudge as I haven’t seen the sample or IP list yet. I realize timelines shift — just checking whether this is still a priority on your side. 

If it helps, a couple of low-effort options to move forward quickly: 
- Share a redacted CSV with only the columns you’re comfortable with (even 50 rows is actionable).
- If security approval is the blocker, we can run the initial pairing session with dummy data to validate the integration and then swap in real data once greenlit.

My calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/dylan/30 (pick a time that works)

If this is no longer a priority, tell me and I’ll pause the kickoff and we can revisit in a month. No pressure — just want to keep our queue tidy.

Thanks,
Dylan

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@luminahealth.com>, Mike Patel <mike.patel@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumina Health trial — kickoff checklist & next steps

Hi Emily / Mike — looping in from Customer Success. Dylan mentioned there’s been radio silence since the sample was expected. Quick offer from our side: we can run a 45-minute "trial kickstart" workshop where our engineer will pair with one of yours and we’ll walk the staging access and a minimal inference run (no PHI required). This often removes the security gating step.

If you’re still interested but overloaded, we can also:
- Put the trial on hold and reopen when you’re ready; or
- Ship a fully redacted demo dataset for an initial integration run.

Could you let us know which you prefer by next Wed (5/5)? If nothing by then, I’ll assume you want to pause and we’ll close out the trial queue to avoid consuming reserved capacity.

Appreciate it,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
